title: Professional Program in LLM Engineering and Agentic AI
description: An applied path to design, build, evaluate, and operate production LLM systems, demonstrate competence through a capstone, and prepare for professional certifications.
outcomes: Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, and Amazon Bedrock models behind provider-neutral, observable contracts.
Design prompts, tools, and structured outputs evaluated with reproducible datasets.
Build and measure RAG systems across retrieval, reranking, grounding, and continuous evaluation.
Orchestrate reliable agents with LangGraph, MCP, memory, traces, and safety boundaries.
Operate LLM applications with observability, cost controls, deployment, and governance.
Defend a production-grade capstone with evidence, metrics, and architectural decisions.
Prepare for AWS Certified AI Practitioner and NVIDIA-Certified Associate Generative AI LLMs.

competencies.label: Foundations and models
competencies.description: Explain transformers, tokenization, inference, and model selection through explicit trade-offs.
competencies.evidence: An executable comparison and a model decision backed by evaluation.

competencies.label: Prompt systems
competencies.description: Treat prompts, schemas, and tools as versioned, testable contracts.
competencies.evidence: A regression dataset and A/B pipeline with explicit criteria.

competencies.label: RAG and retrieval
competencies.description: Design ingestion, chunking, search, reranking, grounding, and RAG evaluation.
competencies.evidence: A measured RAG system with answerable and unanswerable cases, citations, and retrieval metrics.

competencies.label: Agents and MCP
competencies.description: Build graphs, tools, memory, and failure recovery without losing control.
competencies.evidence: An agent with three tools, traces, idempotency, and negative-path tests.

competencies.label: Evaluation
competencies.description: Separate model, retrieval, and application quality through reproducible evaluations.
competencies.evidence: A regression suite with a baseline, rubric, failed samples, and acceptance gates.

competencies.label: LLMOps
competencies.description: Observe latency, cost, quality, safety, and distribution shifts in production.
competencies.evidence: An operational dashboard, alerts, and an incident runbook.

competencies.label: Safety and governance
competencies.description: Model threats, constrain tools, and apply privacy, guardrails, and auditability.
competencies.evidence: A threat model, prompt-injection test, and verifiable controls.

competencies.label: Product architecture
competencies.description: Make build-vs-buy, cost, reliability, and user-experience decisions.
competencies.evidence: ADRs, cost analysis, and a technical capstone defense.

modules.title: LLM Foundations and APIs
modules.description: Transformers, tokenization, generation, current models, and multi-provider clients.
modules.milestone: A multi-provider client with observable tokens, latency, errors, and metadata.

modules.title: Advanced Prompt Engineering
modules.description: Prompts as software: tools, structured outputs, evaluation, versioning, and mitigation.
modules.milestone: A prompt-evaluation pipeline with a dataset, A/B tests, and regression gates in CI.

modules.title: RAG Systems and Evaluation
modules.description: Ingestion, embeddings, vector stores, chunking, reranking, grounding, and RAGAS.
modules.milestone: A RAG application with citations, abstention, and automated evaluation.

modules.title: AI Agents and Orchestration
modules.description: Agentic patterns, LangGraph, MCP, tool use, multi-agent systems, memory, and evaluation.
modules.milestone: A multi-agent system with an MCP server, traces, and failure recovery.

modules.title: LLMOps, Production, and Responsible AI
modules.description: Observability, continuous evaluation, cost, deployment, security, safety, and governance.
modules.milestone: A deployed system with SLOs, costs, evaluations, and an operational runbook.

modules.title: Production Capstone
modules.description: End-to-end project, technical portfolio, deployment, defense, and final preparation.
modules.milestone: An interview-ready system with architecture, metrics, costs, and a live demo.

domains.label: Core Machine Learning and AI Knowledge
